original_finding_content.subject: Cosmetics seller reports 70,000 pesos owed across 13 pending payments (OUT OF WINDOW — Mar 2020)
original_finding_content.raw_text:
- **Finding ID:** F-X13
- **What:** Paty, founder of artisanal cosmetics brand Agua de Nube, reports Kichink owes her 70,000 pesos across 13 pending payments since November 2019 Buen Fin sales.
- **Verbatim snippet:** "A lo mejor no son los millones, pero todos somos empresas chiquitas, y no son los 70,000 pesos que me deben, es que yo contaba con ese dinero"
- **Source:** https://www.xataka.com.mx/comercio-electronico/700-000-pesos-perdidos-100-emprendedores-mexico-plataforma-comercio-electronico-historia-kichinknopaga
- **source_type:** article
- **verification_status:** direct_verified
- **Date:** March 10, 2020
- **Notes:** OUT OF WINDOW. Seller identified as "Paty," Agua de Nube brand (artisanal cosmetics). Business started 2016 with 3 women. 13 pending payments. Paty also stated: "En su momento fue una súper herramienta que nos ayudó a crecer." Unclear if 70,000 pesos is net or gross. Source (Xataka México) directly accessed and verified. Author: Steve Saldaña.
